keyEvents.text: Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 0. Isaac Babadi (Sparta Rotterdam) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Shunsuke Mito.
Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 1. Mateo Chávez (AZ) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ro-Zangelo Daal.
Isaac Babadi (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 1.
Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 2. Calvin Stengs (AZ) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ro-Zangelo Daal.
Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 3. Dave Kwakman (AZ) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mateo Chávez.
Peer Koopmeiners (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, AZ. Jordy Clasie replaces Calvin Stengs.
Substitution, AZ. Bendegúz Kovács replaces Mexx Meerdink.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Andrej Kostic replaces Isaac Babadi.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Giannino Vianello replaces Bas Kuipers.
Bruno Martins Indi (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Andrej Kostic (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 4. Ro-Zangelo Daal (AZ) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mateo Chávez.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Casper Terho replaces Shunsuke Mito.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Alwande Roaldsøy replaces Cedric Hatenboer.
Second yellow card to Bruno Martins Indi (Sparta Rotterdam) for a bad foul.
Substitution, AZ. Valdemar Byskov replaces Dave Kwakman.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Djomar Giersthove replaces Milan Zonneveld.
Substitution, AZ. Wassim Bouziane replaces Ro-Zangelo Daal.
Julian Baas (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, AZ. Seiya Maikuma replaces Elijah Dijkstra.
Delay in match (Sparta Rotterdam).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Sparta Rotterdam 1, AZ 5. Seiya Maikuma (AZ) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Wassim Bouziane with a cross.
